meta.title: Edge case with operator lookup on Unions
meta.fix_ref: none named (maintainer: 'This is addressed in pyright 1.1.339')
meta.build_notes: npm pyright@1.1.338 (2023-11-29) and pyright@1.1.339 (2023-12-06); release window from the maintainer's comment.
meta.notes: Mechanism differs from the screening class (R1 typing): the false positive is reported on a fresh open (the issue's CLI run shows it too); the reporter's remark that an edit sometimes clears it in Pylance is not needed to see the bug.

settings_note: The issue names no settings (pyright CLI 1.1.338 defaults); the session defaults (basic type checking) apply.

files.note: the match statement needs Python 3.10+; the session interpreter is newer

repro.steps: Open main.py. Reported: '~v' in the Bar(v) case is flagged ('Operator "~" not supported for type "FooBar"') although every member of the union derives from _Base0, which implements __invert__ ('v + v' and 'v.__invert__()' are accepted). Probe: no diagnostic about operator '~' may be reported for main.py.
